name: Stick 'Em
summary: Tran'jani in Rog'mar teaches you to throw spears with practice in the Riverglades. Freshwater Crocolisks make his targets, and he hopes the lesson will shape you into a headhunter.

sections.title: A Crocolisk Target
sections.body: Tran'jani in Rog'mar has spears for you and wants you to learn to throw them. The Riverglades are full of Freshwater Crocolisks, which he calls dangerous. He sets them up as targets for your practice.

sections.title: A Headhunter's Promise
sections.body: After your practice, Tran'jani praises your work and says you have the makings of a real headhunter. He asks you to remember him if you become well known.

faq.answer: Tran'jani is the one who gives you spears and teaches you to throw them in Rog'mar.

faq.q: Why does Tran'jani send me after crocolisks?
faq.answer: Tran'jani uses the Freshwater Crocolisks of the Riverglades as targets for spear-throwing practice.

faq.q: What does Tran'jani want me to do?
faq.answer: Tran'jani wants you to practice throwing spears at Freshwater Crocolisks in the Riverglades.
Tran'jani gives you the spears in Rog'mar and points you toward the Riverglades for practice.

faq.q: What does Tran'jani say about the crocolisks?
faq.answer: Tran'jani warns that the Freshwater Crocolisks are dangerous and can snap you up if you are not quick.
